description: Student clubs, events, and campus experience knowledge for the MERI Admission Voice Agent.

examples: Tell me about student life at MERI.
faqs.answer: Beyond academics, MERI offers an active campus life with student clubs, events, personality development programs, and leadership initiatives.
MERI has student-led clubs including the Fashion Club, Literary Club, CSR Club, Music & Dance Club, Photography Club, and Entrepreneurship Cell.

examples: Do you host talks and events?
faqs.answer: MERI regularly organizes seminars, workshops, media talks, alumni talks, and entrepreneurial talks for students.
Yes, MERI includes personality development programs and leadership initiatives as part of the overall student experience.

examples: Can I start a startup while studying?
faqs.answer: MERI has a dedicated Entrepreneurship Cell that supports students interested in exploring startup and entrepreneurial ideas.
MERI hosts cultural activities and competitions throughout the year as part of a balanced campus experience.
